title: 모덕후 ④ 방귀 · 예쁜 사람도 지독할까

lines.en: This issue's special: goddess pictorial.
(gulp) …I bet even her farts smell like roses.
Bro… she's a human being.
Then let's verify. Serious mode on.

lines.text: 오늘은 방귀다. 예쁜 사람 방귀는, 덜 지독할까?
lines.en: Today: farts. Are pretty people's farts any less awful?

lines.text: 첫째. 방귀는 대부분 냄새 없는 기체야.
lines.en: One. Most of a fart is odorless gas.

lines.text: 고약한 건 아주 조금 섞인 황 가스. 썩은 달걀 냄새, 그거.
lines.en: The stink is a tiny bit of sulfur gas. That rotten-egg smell.
So the face doesn't matter?
There's no "face" on the ingredient list.

lines.text: 둘째. 건강한 사람은 하루 열 번쯤 뀐대.
lines.en: Two. A healthy person farts about ten times a day.
No difference between men and women, or by age.
So the lady in the magazine…

lines.text: …하루 열 번. 오늘도 벌써 몇 번.
lines.en: …Ten a day. A few already today.

lines.text: 셋째. 방귀를 모아서 심사위원 둘이 냄새를 채점한 실험이 있어.
lines.en: Three. In one study, two judges scored the smell of collected farts.

lines.text: 여자 쪽이 더 진했는데, 남자는 한 번에 양이 많았대.
lines.en: Women's were more concentrated, but men's came out in bigger volumes.
So the total stink per fart: a tie.
What did those judges ever do wrong?
…I salute them.

lines.text: 넷째. 냄새는 얼굴이 아니라 접시가 정해.
lines.en: Four. It's not the face that decides the smell, it's the plate.

lines.text: 고기를 많이 먹을수록, 장 속 황 성분이 확 늘었대.
lines.en: The more meat people ate, the more sulfur showed up in their gut.
You had two servings of pork belly yesterday.
…One of them was for research.

lines.text: 다섯째. 예쁘면 다 좋을 거라고 믿는 착각, 후광 효과.
lines.en: Five. Believing beautiful means good at everything: the halo effect.

lines.text: 장미 향은 코가 아니라, 내 뇌가 만든 거야.
lines.en: The rose scent wasn't made by her. It was made by my brain.
Your brain's a perfume shop.
Conclusion: pretty people fart just the same.

lines.text: 대신 몸 냄새는, 남의 것보다 내 것, 연인 것을 덜 역하게 느낀대.
lines.en: But with body odor, we find our own, and our partner's, less gross than a stranger's.
So if it doesn't gross you out, that's love.
(toot) Oops, sorry.
It's fine. I can't smell a thing.
(gulp) …So that's what love looks like.
(toot) …Hm? Mine smells like roses.
Self-odor bias: confirmed.
